title: The Fallen Throne
summary: Mastering the Sovereign Domain, Ha-Jun explores the ancient Throne of Asmodaius, discovering the hidden mechanism leading into the Sacred Memory Chamber beneath the summit.

panels.shot: 500-meter sovereign domain sphere shimmering wide shot
panels.action: A massive translucent violet sphere of sovereign authority encloses the entire summit plateau.

panels.shot: gravity and atmospheric pressure bending inside domain
panels.action: Loose diamond dust and stone pebbles float weightlessly in midair within the boundaries of the domain.

panels.shot: ha-jun descending throne steps with effortless grace
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps down the marble staircase, Crown gleaming, his dark coat rustling with sovereign dignity.

panels.shot: tae-jun standing up and smiling warmly
panels.action: Tae-Jun clasps his younger brother's hand: 'Tumhara domain... Maine aisi presence 7 saalo mein nahi dekhi.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Poori mountain tumhare rhythm par saans le rahi hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun dispelling the floating stones with a flick
panels.action: With a subtle twitch of his ring finger, the floating stones settle gently back onto the ground.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yeh Crown bas weapon nahi hai... Yeh is realm ka steering wheel hai.

panels.shot: kuro hopping onto the throne backrest
panels.action: Kuro pecks at a hidden demonic crest carved into the obsidian backrest: 'Lekin Asmodaius ka asli treasure niche hai!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Throne ke theek niche The Sacred Memory Chamber hai!

panels.shot: ha-jun examining the throne seat
panels.action: In the center of the dark seat: an intricate nine-pointed star depression matching Ha-Jun's Sovereign Crest.

panels.shot: ha-jun pressing right palm onto the star depression
panels.action: Ha-Jun presses his bare palm into the depression, conducting a pulse of crimson blood mana.

panels.shot: thunderous grinding of ancient gears inside the mountain
panels.action: Deep inside Mount Obsidian, colossal subterranean counterweights shift with seismic rumbles.

panels.shot: central throne splitting and parting into two halves
panels.action: The 40-foot obsidian throne splits down the middle, sliding apart along concealed bronze tracks.

panels.shot: circular descending staircase of crystal revealed
panels.action: Beneath the throne opens a 20-foot wide circular staircase of glowing amethyst steps spiraling down.

panels.shot: ha-jun peering into the glowing subterranean depths
panels.action: Cool, scented air smelling of ancient scrolls and cedarwood wafts upward from the illuminated depths.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Hazaaron saal purani kitabo ki khushboo... Yeh koi dungeon nahi hai, yeh library hai.

panels.shot: kuro flying down first as scout
panels.action: Kuro glides into the opening: 'The Memory Archives of Asmodaius! Jahan universe ka sach band hai!'

panels.shot: ha-jun and tae-jun descending the amethyst steps
panels.action: The two brothers walk side-by-side down the luminous purple crystal spiral staircase.

panels.shot: walls lined with millions of floating crystal memory orbs
panels.action: The subterranean hall opens into a colossal hollow cavern lined with millions of glowing data spheres.

panels.shot: central holographic pedestal in the archive chamber
panels.action: In the heart of the archives: a crystalline dais projecting a 3D star map of the mortal and abyssal realms.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the central star map
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches out to touch the holographic representation of Earth and the Abyss linked by red lines.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Earth aur Demon Realm... Pehle ek hi universe ka hissa the?

panels.shot: tae-jun reading an ancient holographic text
panels.action: Tae-Jun swipes through floating cuneiform symbols: 'Haan... 10,000 saal pehle tak koi Gate nahi tha.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Dono realms ek saath exist karte the... Jab tak 'The Void Primordial' nahi aaya.

panels.shot: ha-jun turning sharply to tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun looks up: 'The Void Primordial... Yeh kaun hai?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Asmodaius ne bhi is entity ka naam liya tha.

panels.shot: kuro expression turning somber and dark
panels.action: Kuro lands on the pedestal: 'Woh entity kisi realm ki nahi hai... Woh universal entropy ka avatar hai.'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Void Primordial har universe ke mana ko devour karta hai jab tak sabkuch black na ho jaye.

panels.shot: archive orb projecting historical memory hologram
panels.action: A glowing gold orb projects a colossal memory playback in the center of the chamber.

panels.shot: hologram showing the first sovereign in his prime
panels.action: Lord Asmodaius, a towering emperor in midnight armor with four horns, presiding over a golden civilization.

panels.shot: seven demon kings kneeling before asmodaius
panels.action: Seven crowned demon lords swearing absolute fealty before the Sovereign's throne.

dialogue.text: Seven Demon Kings Sovereign ke sabse faithful generals the... Lekin Void ne unke dimaago mein poison daal diya.

panels.shot: black void worms infecting the demon kings' brains
panels.action: Terrifying microscopic black parasites burrowing into the demon kings' eyes, turning them into puppets.

panels.shot: ha-jun staring in shock at the parasite footage
panels.action: Ha-Jun covers his mouth: 'Woh demon kings evil nahi the... Woh mind-controlled the!'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: The Seven Kings were infected by the Void!

panels.shot: tae-jun pointing to the infection records
panels.action: Tae-Jun highlights a medical file: 'Director Kang ke laboratory mein wahi same parasite mila tha!'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Hunter Bureau bhi usi Void Cult ka tool thi, Ha-Jun! Same infection!

panels.shot: ha-jun realization dawning like lightning
panels.action: Everything connects in Ha-Jun's mind: humans, demons, hunters—all manipulated by the same unseen horror.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Asli dushman na Humans the na Demons... Asli dushman 'The Void' hai!

panels.shot: a second secret vault door in the archive floor
panels.action: Behind the star map pedestal, a circular hatch engraved with an eclipse crescent glows pitch-black.

panels.shot: kuro pointing to the crescent hatch
panels.action: Kuro spreads his wings: 'Wahan rests the second Legendary Relic: Eclipse Devourer!'

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: The Void-slaying blade! The Eclipse Devourer!

panels.shot: ha-jun walking toward the eclipse hatch with drawn breath
panels.action: Ha-Jun steps up to the dark portal, his Crown resonating with ancient anticipation.
panels.mood: ready for the blade of eclipse

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Let us forge the blade that will end the Void.
